title: The tuning values of the MVP: every key of its table 3 and the reference keys the simulation reads (MVP-003, MVP-099).
description: One record, GameData/Records/tuning/mvp.json. Each field path is its tuning key (CONVENTIONS §4).

mvp.description: the mvp.* keys of the MVP scope, table 3

ref.description: the reference keys the MVP reads from data

tick_period.description: ref.sim.tick_period (MVP-092, ADR-079): the period of one tick

default_front.description: ref.sim.spawn.default_front (R-SIM-226): the front of a figure spawned at rest, by component

share.x-species-unit: picks per live ungrouped actor per tick

settled_fade_factor.x-species-unit: times the fading rate of a grievance whose cause remains
